@graph.description: Mistral Large 4 is in public preview. Compare API context limits, launch prices, regional restrictions, and the checks to make before switching your workflow.

mainEntity.name: Can I download Mistral Large 4 now?

acceptedAnswer.text: The sources checked on October 8 describe hosted public preview access and weights planned by the end of October. Verify the official release before planning a downloadable deployment.

mainEntity.name: Why does OpenRouter list a smaller context window?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its listing publishes a different allowance for its API route. Use that route’s documented limit; the pages reviewed do not establish the reason for the difference.

mainEntity.name: Does EU inference mean all account data stays in the EU?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Mistral says regional inference does not provide regional storage for all control-plane data, including billing and account configuration.
